scope.purpose: Decompose captured genotype-field prose and table-adjacent constraints into reviewable atomic candidates; not an approved conformance ledger.

method: Use exact pinned source passages and preserve version scope.
Split independent behaviors (presence, ordering, missingness, ploidy, semantics) into separate candidates.
Do not infer requirements for a version when its source passage was not captured.
Keep descriptive definitions distinct from normative MUST/SHOULD/MAY force.
Record unresolved cross-reference, table, grammar and exception work explicitly.

No implementation, test, interoperability or laboratory qualification evidence is claimed.
